# Mobility Era Game — Financial Literacy & European Civic Education Board Game

> Mobility Era is an evidence-based educational board game and digital companion app developed by Researchista (The Hague, Netherlands & Luxembourg). It teaches young people aged 14+ real-life financial literacy, taxation, public budget solidarity, and European civic rights across 41+ European countries in a single 60-minute classroom period.

## Key Facts & Empirical Evidence
- **Framework Alignment**: Aligned with the official EU/OECD-INFE Financial Competence Framework for Children and Youth (2023) across 4 core areas: Money & Transactions (100% covered), Planning & Managing Finances (~75% covered), Risk & Reward, and Financial Landscape (Public Budget mechanism).
- **National Pilot Study (Luxembourg)**: Empirically tested with 195 secondary school students across 10 schools in Luxembourg (English, French, and German tracks) under SCRIPT (Ministry of Education, Luxembourg) data governance.
- **Research Publication**: Working Paper by Dr. Irina Burlacu-De Paoli (UNU-MERIT / Maastricht University), financed by the European Investment Bank Institute (EIBI).
- **Measured Learning Gains**:
  - 95% of students demonstrated solid comprehension of gross vs. net income and taxation.
  - 52% of students volunteered to play again.
  - +10% demonstrated increase in European Union civic awareness.
  - Survey breakdown of top student takeaways: 40% Geography & European country facts, 35% Taxes & public finance mechanisms, 19% Money management & economics, 6% Life situations & social safety nets.
- **Recognition & Memberships**:
  - Triple E Awards 2023 — European Prize Winner (Community Engagement)
  - BAFTA Games Beyond Entertainment 2024 (Stage 2)
  - Member of Dutch EdTech & Luxembourg Startup Association
  - Registered Trademark: BOIP Reg. #1395977 (Class 28.41)
